scope: all 929 outer-test images across five mutually exclusive folds

primary_metric.name: image_weighted_foreground_f1
primary_metric.per_image_score: arithmetic mean of crack F1 and craquelure F1 for classes present in that image's GT
primary_metric.image_weight: (GT crack pixels + GT craquelure pixels) / valid pixels

diagnostic_metric.name: image_weighted_binary_foreground_f1
diagnostic_metric.description: collapse crack and craquelure into one foreground class before computing per-image F1, then use the same GT foreground-fraction image weights
